The diagram shows a ball P, of mass $4.0 \text{ kg}$, moving to the right at $10 \text{ ms}^{-1}$ directly towards a stationary ball Q, of mass $2.0 \text{ kg}$.
The balls collide but do not join together. Immediately after the collision ball Q moves at $10 \text{ ms}^{-1}$ to the right.
What is the velocity of ball P immediately after the collision, and how much kinetic energy in total is lost during the collision?

|  | velocity of ball P after collision | kinetic energy lost during collision / J |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 0 | 50 |
| B | 0 | 150 |
| C | $10 \text{ ms}^{-1}$ to the left | 50 |
| D | $10 \text{ ms}^{-1}$ to the left | 150 |
| E | $5.0 \text{ ms}^{-1}$ to the right | 50 |
| F | $5.0 \text{ ms}^{-1}$ to the right | 150 |
